verdict.rationale: Pinecone's own Inference API documents reranking of results with reranking models hosted on Pinecone's infrastructure, so it ships a first-party reranking capability. The evidence is a single repeated one-line mention, with no detail on available models or on reranking inside the search/query call. missing for 10: list of available reranking models, documented integration of reranking into the search/query pipeline (e.g., a rerank parameter on search), usage guide/parameters, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can rerank search results with built-in or first-party-integrated reranking models

citations.quote: Use the Inference API to generate vector embeddings and rerank results using embedding models and reranking models hosted on Pinecone's infrastructure.
